params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Nocturne}} next basic attack causes him to slash in a circle that deals {{as|'''increased''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies, {{tip|heal|healing}} him for each enemy hit.
params.blurb2: Basic attacks {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Umbra Blade's'' cooldown, increased against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Nocturne''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to slash in a circle, dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies and {{tip|healing}} himself for {{pp|13 + (30-13)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} per enemy hit. Against {{tip|minions}}, ''Umbra Blades' '' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50% and it applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to all targets{{bug|2}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.description2: ''Umbra Blades'' can {{tip|critically strike}} against the primary target, modifying the {{as|physical damage}} dealt to{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nocturne|crit_base}}|100|mod=1.1}} AD.|AD}}|{{as|110% AD}}{{times}}{{sti|{{as|'''total''' critical damage}}}}.}}
params.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* The primary target of the enhanced attack is dealt {{tip|basic damage}} while the secondary targets of the slash are dealt {{tip|proc damage}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** Basic attacks against them will still grant the cooldown reduction.
* Parry effects will only block the damage dealt to the primary target.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nocturne}} casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a ''Dusk Trail'' in its wake, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit will leave a ''Dusk Trail'' in their wake for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: While on the ''Dusk Trail'', Nocturne is {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a ''Dusk Trail'' in its wake, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit will leave a ''Dusk Trail'' behind while moving. ''Dusk Trails'' last 5 seconds and will slowly disappear afterwards.
params.description2: While on the ''Dusk Trail'', '''Nocturne''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|15 to 55}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
params.notes:
* ''Duskbringer'' checks for and hits targets 25 units outside of the missile's maximum range.
* ''Duskbringer's'' damage is not increased by the {{as|'''bonus''' AD}} gained from its trail, meaning that casting it again while on the trail from the last cast will not result in higher damage.
** It is observed from seasons ago that this is intentionally hard-coded into the ability to avoid the projectile increasing its own damage. This feature is somewhat deprecated as it also limits chain-casting ''Duskbringer''.
* ''Duskbringer's Dusk Trail'' will expose the path of affected units until its duration ends. It is a form of {{tip|obscured vision}}; the trail indirectly reveals the location of enemy units even in the fog of war, including those shrouded by {{tip|stealth}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage and also prevents the ''Dusk Trail'' from following the target.
* The formed ''Dusk Trail'' does not disappear if ''Duskbringer'' is intercepted by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of movement speed boosts.

blurb.plain: Active: Nocturne casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a Dusk Trail in its wake, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. Enemy champions hit will leave a Dusk Trail in their wake for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: While on the Dusk Trail, Nocturne is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed and bonus attack damage.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' gains a brief {{tip|spell shield}}. If it blocks an ability, the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} is doubled for a few seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, ''Shroud of Darkness' ''{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} is doubled for 5 seconds.
params.notes: * If ''Shroud of Darkness'' is active when '''Nocturne''' re-casts ''{{ai|Paranoia|Nocturne}}'' to dash to a target, its duration is refreshed every {{fd|0.25 seconds}} during the dash.

blurb.plain: Passive: Nocturne gains bonus attack speed.

blurb2.plain: Active: Nocturne gains a brief spell shield. If it blocks an ability, the bonus attack speed is doubled for a few seconds.

description.plain: Passive: Nocturne gains bonus attack speed.

description2.plain: Active: Nocturne gains a spell shield for 1.5 seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, Shroud of Darkness' bonus attack speed is doubled for 5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Nocturne}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving towards {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} that continually deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb3: If the tether is not broken after a short time, the target is briefly {{tip|fear|feared}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nocturne''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration.
params.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|80/4 to 260/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/4}}% AP)}}}}
params.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is {{tip|fear|feared}} for a duration while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90%.
params.notes:
* ''Unspeakable Horror'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* Feared enemies in a {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 180° total angle within '''Nocturne's''' facing direction will trigger ''Unspeakable Horror's'' passive.
* Casting ''Unspeakable Horror'' may grant '''Nocturne''' permanent {{tip|ghosting}} until he has [[death|died]].{{bug}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.

blurb.plain: Passive: Nocturne gains bonus movement speed while moving towards feared targets.

blurb2.plain: Active: Nocturne torments the target, forming a tether that continually deals magic damage.

blurb3.plain: If the tether is not broken after a short time, the target is briefly feared and slowed.

description.plain: Passive: Nocturne gains 90% bonus movement speed while facing nearby feared targets.

description2.plain: Active: Nocturne torments the target, forming a tether between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes magic damage every 0.5 seconds over the duration.

description3.plain: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is feared for a duration while being slowed by 90%.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nocturne}} terrorizes all enemy champions, {{tip|nearsight|nearsighting}} them for a few seconds. He can recast ''Paranoia'' during this time.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nocturne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' terrorizes all enemy champions, {{tip|nearsight|nearsighting}} them for 6 seconds, during which their {{tip|sight}} radius is reduced by {{tt|300 units|Total sight radius of enemy champions after reduction is 1050 units.}}. He can recast ''Paranoia'' for the same duration after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nocturne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.
params.description3: '''''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] and [[Active_ability_items|item actives]] during the dash.''
params.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 100}}|Starts after recast times out or is used}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target unit to cast (recast)
params.notes:
* '''Nocturne''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will not stop tracking the target until he reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
<!-- outdated as of 25.23 ** He will dash to the target's previous location without dealing damage if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{ap|3500|4250|5000}} (based on ''Paranoia's'' rank) units.-->
* Enemy players affected by ''Paranoia's'' {{tip|nearsight}} cannot interact with the allied portrait icons on the HUD.
* ''Paranoia's'' {{tip|nearsight}} will apply to enemy champions that are {{tip|untargetable}} or are dead, and will persist through {{tip|death}}.
* '''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]], [[summoner spell|summoner spells]] (excluding {{si|Hexflash}}), or [[active ability items|item actives]] during flight.
** Using a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} ability will interrupt the flight.
** The flight will also be interrupted if '''Nocturne''' is affected by a {{ui|Blast Cone}} triggered by an allied champion.{{bug|1}}<!-- Has only been tested with the chemtech map's blast cones -->
* ''Paranoia'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* ''Paranoia's'' {{tip|nearsight}} does not apply to {{tip|clone|clones}}.
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* [[summoner|Players']] screens will turn a different color when ''Paranoia'' is cast, based on their perspective: blue for allies and red for enemies.
** If an existing player overlay is overwritten, it will not be added back once ''Paranoia'' ends. [https://www.twitch.tv/scrubnoob/clip/BoxyEmpathicJayBCouch-6jetjjqssFUY5ACY] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Nocturne R; Rengar R|estimatedPatchOrigin=V1.0.0.113|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1776209439|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Nocturne/Paranoia
}}
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate immediately upon ''Paranoia's'' first cast. If the recast is used, the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the dash.
* A [[spell indicator]] telegraphed to '''Nocturne''' and his allies will be placed on all enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} within range of ''Paranoia's'' recast while the ability is active. ''The following images display the indicator for the default [[skin]]:''
[[File:Nocturne_Original_Paranoia_Indicator_Red.png|thumb|left|A glowing '''{{color|#8b0000|red silhouette}}''' of '''Nocturne's''' blades indicates an enemy champion can be targeted by ''Paranoia's'' recast.]]
[[File:Nocturne Original Paranoia Indicator.png|thumb|left|A glowing '''{{color|#32CD32|green silhouette}}''' of '''Nocturne's''' blades signifies an enemy champion has been targeted by ''Paranoia's'' recast.]]
